I replied to Tobias in the channel thread: the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet problem is **ticket #88412**.

Tobias raised it himself in #central-team, a channel he's in, on 2 Jul 2025. The tablet at Door 6 froze on the bill of lading barcode scan, and their night shift lead linked it to Quarendon Freightways drivers arriving with split manifests. I didn't find any later update in that channel saying whether it was resolved.
